north_star.value_moment: An account completes a useful workflow and saves the result.

metrics.name: Weekly activated accounts
metrics.question: How many accounts experienced the core value this week?
metrics.formula: count_distinct(account_id where project_created and result_saved within 7d)
metrics.decision_rule: If growth is flat for two weekly cohorts, inspect activation steps before increasing acquisition.

metrics.name: Signup-to-activation rate
metrics.question: What share of new accounts reaches the value moment?
metrics.decision_rule: Investigate any segment falling more than 15% below its four-week baseline.

metrics.name: Gross margin percent
metrics.question: Does usage remain economically sustainable?
metrics.decision_rule: Freeze scale-up when any paid plan is negative at the 90th usage percentile.

metrics.name: Error-free sessions
metrics.question: Can users complete work without an application error?
metrics.decision_rule: Stop rollout when the current release regresses by more than 1 percentage point.

events.name: signup_completed
events.description: The server created the user and initial account.

events.name: project_created
events.description: The server persisted the account's first useful project.

events.name: result_saved
events.description: The server persisted a generated result selected by the user.

events.name: experiment_exposed
events.description: The assignment service exposed an eligible account to a variant.

experiments.hypothesis: A shorter guided first workflow increases seven-day activation without reducing reliability or margin.
experiments.eligible_cohort: New self-serve accounts with no completed project
experiments.decision_rule: Ship only after the planned analysis window when activation improves and neither guardrail crosses its stop threshold.
